summary: Tested super-admin company status management (active/trial/paused/cancelled), delete with security word ELIMINAR, access blocking, and cron purge. Backend: 8/9 pytest pass. Status transitions, trial_ends=+30d, paused_at, cancelled_at+purge_after=+60d, purge_after removal, 'Estado: X → Y (motivo)' history, 400/404/403 handling, login 403 with clear message, existing token 403 on /api/dashboard, public portal 403, super admin still enters via X-Company-Id, reactivation restores login, delete with wrong/missing word gives 400, ELIMINAR purges every collection by company_id and records deleted_companies, cron 401/200/duplicate, and the purge only removes cancelled companies with past purge_after. UI: status panel (current status disabled with 'Actual'), confirm dialog with cancel/ok, reason saved in history, trial-ends text, 'En pausa' badge, delete dialog only enabled for exact 'ELIMINAR', row removed and sheet closed after delete. Fixed 1 bug: company-purge-date never showed.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Cuerpo inválido' when the request has a valid Bearer token and X-Webhook-Id but no JSON body. If the scheduler sends an empty body, the cron never runs. Treat a missing/invalid body as {} instead of raising.

Paused companies are not blocked: the check only covers ('suspended','cancelled'). A paused company that finished setup gets full AI bot replies, which contradicts the UI text 'Portal y WhatsApp detenidos'. Add 'paused' to the check.
No reference is kept to the task, so it can be garbage-collected and errors are swallowed silently. Keep a reference and log exceptions.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: company-purge-date never rendered because billing.statement() whitelisted company fields without purge_after. coupon_pct was also missing, so the 'Precio preferencial' input always showed 0.

integration_issues.flow: Existing session of an admin whose company becomes paused/cancelled
integration_issues.issue: /api/auth/me still returns 200, so the app loads an empty shell ('Configuremos su salón' with a blank body). The 403 block message is not shown and the user is not logged out. Show the BLOCKED message, e.g. return company status in /auth/me and have the frontend force logout with a toast, or handle 403 in an axios interceptor.

action_items: Cron endpoint: do not fail with 400 on an empty body (use body = {} fallback)
routes_wa.handle_inbound: also block 'paused' companies (currently only suspended/cancelled)
Handle a paused/cancelled company for already logged-in users: show the block message and log them out instead of an empty dashboard
Keep a reference to and log errors from the asyncio.create_task(purge_expired())
critical_code_review_comments: billing.statement company whitelist was missing purge_after/coupon_pct (fixed). Consider returning the full company minus settings/card secrets.
set_company_status removes purge_after for paused too (paused from cancelled cancels the purge). This seems reasonable but is undocumented.
Company-admin self-cancel (/billing/cancel) puts the company in 'cancelled', and ctx then blocks even /billing, so the company cannot reactivate itself. Confirm this is intended.
wwwpruebacom is 'cancelled' with no purge_after (cancelled at 16:33 today, not by this agent), so the cron will never purge it.
updated_files: /app/backend/billing.py (statement company whitelist: added coupon_pct, purge_after, cancelled_at, paused_at, status_reason)
seed_data_creation: TEST_Co* companies were created and all deleted at the end (verified: only bellavida, salon-retest-trinity and wwwpruebacom remain). TEST_run_* entries remain in cron_runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with -n 0 (no xdist). The module cleanup deletes all TEST_Co* companies, and parallel workers interfere. test_no_body is expected to fail until the cron empty-body fix lands. ui_setup_status.py 'ui' creates test-co-ui, 'wa' checks paused WA inbound.
rca of the issue: company-purge-date missing: AdminCompanies Detail loads /admin/companies/{id}/statement, which returns statement()['company'], a hardcoded subset of fields without purge_after. The condition company.status==='cancelled' && company.purge_after was therefore always false. Fixed by adding the fields to the whitelist in billing.py, verified in the UI ('Los datos se borrarán el 2026-12-15').
